A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe the same MeanCache work, with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Pages 2–20 have identical extracted text and rendered content.

before.justification: v1 reports original image and video generation experiments, ablations, and supplementary comparisons in Section 3 and Appendix B, including Tables 1–3 and 5.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original empirical results on FLUX.1 [dev], Qwen-Image, and HunyuanVideo, including the appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same cached-JVP average-velocity estimator and peak-suppressed shortest-path scheduling procedure. No method components or inference steps change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same image and video tasks, DrawBench evaluation, T2V-CompBench prompts, VBench evaluation, and rare-word test scenarios. No coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1, 2, and 5 and the qualitative comparisons, including DBCache plus TaylorSeer and Qwen-Image-Distill-Full.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendices A.2–A.4 retain identical model configurations, budgets, metrics, sample counts, and testing procedures, including CPU offloading for HunyuanVideo.

E4.justification: The shortest-path analysis, peak-suppression ablation, rare-word consistency tests, efficiency–performance analysis, and supplementary qualitative examples are unchanged in Section 3.4 and Appendix B.

E5.justification: Section 3.1 retains the same statement that prompt sampling is repeated five times with different seeds and results are averaged. Statistical and uncertainty reporting is unchanged throughout.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are retained. For example, Tables 1 and 2 report the same MeanCache speedups of 4.12×, 4.56×, and 3.59×; the appendix results are also identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, estimator derivations, scheduling objective, and start-point MeanFlow identity proof in Appendix A.1 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about average-velocity caching, trajectory stability, training-free acceleration, and generation quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations of JVP stability, cache timing, high-acceleration behavior, and caching versus distillation remain identical. No applicability boundaries or substantive limitations are added or revised.

D1.justification: v2 adds a clickable 'Code: UnicomAI/MeanCache' repository reference on page 1; v1 only states plans to release code. Implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs establish new access information but do not establish the repository's availability or completeness.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and research positioning are identical. The new link identifies the authors' code rather than adding related work.

P1.justification: Front matter gains a one-line code reference and an updated arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added code line slightly shifts the abstract and Figure 1 downward on page 1. Figure content and captions are unchanged, and pages 2–20 render identically.

improvement.justification: The direct code link provides a concrete resource pointer beyond v1's future-release statement, modestly improving discoverability and reproducibility documentation. Scientific content and evidence are unchanged, and the PDFs alone cannot establish the linked implementation's completeness.
